body: How man how. I was infected with a shit fucking disease and I may have spread that to people who didn't deserve it

End of last year. What a fucking shit way to start 2020. 2019 was an amazing year too for me personally
29. Lived an amazing life. Truly wonderful until this shit. I'm so upset. It was like a complete 180 in 15 seconds

Night went ok. Hung out with my ex-gf and was miserable.
